exposure: likes sour food or hates greasy food
not worrying about delivery without family members
electronic screen exposure time more than 5 h per day
cohort: 535 pregnant women in their third trimester visiting Lianyungang Maternal and Child Health Hospital in Jiangsu Province, Eastern China
finding: The prevalence of fear of childbirth (FOC) was high (56.64%) among pregnant women in their third trimester, and several factors were associated with FOC, including electronic screen exposure time, history of cesarean section, food preferences, anxiety, depression, parity, family function, and doctor-patient communication.
mod_finding: Women with no history of cesarean section were more likely to have a greater level of FOC.
